housing: Saint Paul renters live in duplexes, fourplexes and older brick walk-up apartment buildings, alongside single-family homes and newer apartments along the Green Line.

localRules.text: Saint Paul's Tenant Protections Ordinance, in effect from May 14, 2026, caps security deposits at one month's rent, with a possible extra month in limited cases.

tenantHelp.name: City of Saint Paul Tenant Protections

climate: Test the furnace, check windows and doors for drafts and frost, and look for ice dam or water stains on ceilings; winters are long and very cold.
fact: Saint Paul is one of the few US cities with a voter-approved rent stabilization law.
